# San Antonio Recovery Center

> > Comprehensive addiction treatment and mental health services in San Antonio, Texas, offering evidence-based therapies, medical detox, and holistic recovery programs.

San Antonio Recovery Center (SARC) provides specialized treatment for substance use disorders including opioid addiction, alcohol use disorder, polysubstance abuse, and co-occurring mental health conditions. The center offers multiple levels of care including residential treatment, intensive outpatient programs (IOP), medication-assisted treatment (MAT), and evidence-based therapies such as CBT, EMDR, and holistic approaches.

## Key Topics

- Addiction Treatment
- Substance Use Disorder
- Medical Detox
- Opioid Addiction (heroin, oxycodone, hydrocodone, morphine)
- Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT)
- Dual Diagnosis & Co-occurring Disorders
- Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Intensive Outpatient Programs (IOP)
- Residential Treatment
- Alcohol Use Disorder & Withdrawal
- Polysubstance Abuse
- EMDR Therapy
- Aftercare & Relapse Prevention
- 12-Step Programs (AA, NA)
- Holistic Treatment Approaches
